messages:
John G. (Globex): Hi — our invoice INV-2026-0054 (issued 2026-03-05) is missing our PO number. It should show PO-98765. Payment was processed by card (txn_3L9F) on 2026-03-06. Can you reissue a corrected invoice for our auditor?

maya (Support): Thanks John — sorry about that. Routing to billing/finance. Can you confirm the exact invoice amount and whether you want a refund or for us to reallocate the payment to a corrected invoice? :handshake:

ops-bot: Payment succeeded for INV-2026-0054 — amount $12,340.00, txn id txn_3L9F, payment method: card ****4242.

alex_billing (Billing): Quick heads-up on process: we cannot edit a finalized PDF once paid. Standard flow is: 1) issue a credit note for INV-2026-0054, 2) create a new invoice that includes PO-98765, 3) reapply the original payment to the new invoice or refund the card and have the customer pay the new invoice. For card payments we prefer reallocation to avoid refunds.

maya (Support): Alex — can you outline the internal steps and ETA? John — what do you prefer (refund vs reallocate)?

John G. (Globex): Reallocate please, that'd be ideal. Our auditors just need the invoice PDF with the PO printed. No refunds.

sofia_finance (Finance): Reallocation is OK but we need written authorization from Globex and the customer's VAT ID for EU VAT handling. High-level steps I'll run:
- Issue credit note CN-2026-014 linked to INV-2026-0054
- Create new invoice INV-2026-0054-R1 with PO-98765 (duplicate original, add PO)
- Reapply payment txn_3L9F to INV-2026-0054-R1 and mark CN as applied
- Post journal entries and send updated PDFs to customer
ETA: 2-3 business days after I get authorization + VAT ID.

alex_billing (Billing): Internal UI path for reference: Billing UI -> Invoices -> search INV-2026-0054 -> Actions -> Issue credit note -> Reason: "PO correction" -> Link payment txn_3L9F. Then Invoices -> New -> Duplicate original invoice -> Update PO field -> Save -> Mark as "Pending reallocation".

maya (Support): John — please reply here with a one-line authorization so finance can proceed. Eg: 'Globex authorizes Redwood to reallocate payment txn_3L9F to the reissued invoice INV-2026-0054-R1' and include VAT ID if applicable.

John G. (Globex): "Globex authorizes Redwood to reallocate payment txn_3L9F to the reissued invoice INV-2026-0054-R1" VAT ID: EU123456789

sofia_finance (Finance): Thanks — starting work now. I'll create a Jira finance ticket and attach the CN + new invoice PDFs when done.

ops-bot: Jira ticket FIN-4421 created by sofia_finance: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FIN-4421

sofia_finance (Finance): Update: CN created CN-2026-014 and new invoice INV-2026-0054-R1 with PO-98765. Reallocation scheduled; posting ledger entries and sending customer-facing PDFs now. Expect final email & PDFs within 24-48 hours.

John G. (Globex): Great, thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround :clap:

maya (Support): Will follow up here after PDFs are delivered. Marking for resolution once customer confirms receipt. :white_check_mark:

alex_billing (Billing): FYI for the backlog — consider small UX change: allow editing PO on "paid" invoices only to create the CN+reissue flow in one click; filed BILL-989 to track.

ops-bot: Backlog task created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-989"
